meta.title: Squirrel Commits Nut Heist — Bird Feeder Bandit

scenes.narration_en: A sneaky squirrel eyes the bird feeder from across the yard.
He performs an acrobatic leap onto the feeder, hanging upside down.
The birds watch in annoyance as he stuffs his cheeks full of seeds.
He makes a getaway across the fence, seed thief of the year.
The birds hold a committee meeting to discuss feeder security.
